{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance'' armor}}
Below is a list of all the armor that appear in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''.

{{See|Final Fantasy Tactics Advance accessories}}

== Headgear ==
=== Helmets ===
Helmets are sturdy metallic pieces of headgear can be equipped by [[Soldier (Tactics Advance)|Soldiers]], [[Paladin (Tactics Advance)|Paladins]], [[Warrior (Tactics Advance)|Warriors]], [[Templar (Tactics Advance)|Templars]], [[Defender (Tactics Advance)|Defenders]], [[Dragoon (Tactics Advance)|Dragoons]], and [[Mog Knight]]s.

== Shields ==
Shields are one-handed defensive equipment that can be used with a one-handed weapon (or a two-handed weapon with the ability Monkey Grip). They can be used by the Soldier, Paladin, Warrior, Sage, Fencer, and Mog Knight jobs, as well as anyone with the Shieldbearer S-Ability.
